GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 132 (11 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 418)
APO 500
11 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Release of Blocked Funds of Askania K. K.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. Memorandum No. 595(5), dated 16 November 1945, transmitting applications No. 008, 009, 010, 011, and 012 of Askania K. K. for release of blocked funds.
2. Applications No. 008, 009, 010, and 012 are denied and the funds concerned will remain blocked.
3. Authority is granted for payment of salaries for October, November, and December, 1945, as outlined in Application No. Oil, not to exceed the amount of ¥24,924 for the entire three months. Payments to German nationals employed by this company will be paid directly into blocked bank accounts of such persons.
4. Acknowledgement of receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
